title: internal/runstate full-suite test fails on this host at the base commit — the maintenance fixture never arms
body: TestTheStoresFetchStartsNoMaintenanceInTheRepositoryItWritesTo (internal/runstate/maintenance_test.go) fails with "a plain `git fetch` in the armed repository started no maintenance; this fixture proves nothing" under this host's git (2.50.1 Apple build). Reproduced at dd656bd282c8 in a clean worktree, so it predates mn7 and is environment-dependent: the full (non-short) suite cannot go green on this host for ANY tick until the fixture arms under current git versions or skips when it cannot. This is the one reason mn7's 'full suite passes' criterion is not literally demonstrable here.
